subject: general
question:
The accompanying graph shows the rainfall in (in mm) in a town during seven days of a week and the percentage of rainfall during the daytime. On which two days did it rain most (in mm) during the daytime? 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e6b2434fd4a46e762fcdb9f619fd06f435535889664fe4ca9d736b23c524ba.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Rainfall during seven days and daytime percentage is provided.

**Calculation:**

Daytime Rainfall

Sunday: 170 mm × 0% = 0 mm

Monday: 230 mm × 40% = 92 mm

Tuesday: 150 mm × 35% = 52.5 mm

Wednesday: 200 mm × 35% = 70 mm

Thursday: 170 mm × 30% = 51 mm

Friday: 140 mm × 60% = 84 mm

Saturday: 120 mm × 50% = 60 mm

The top two days: Monday and Friday.

**∴ The two days with the most rainfall during the daytime are Monday and Friday.**
